title: Point Cloud Segmentation for Autonomous Clip Positioning in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy on a Phantom
summary: High-risk applications in robotics, such as robot-assisted surgery, present unique challenges. These systems must be both highly precise and interpretable in order to be deployed in environments with very low tolerance for error or unsafe exploration. We present the first robotic system to demonstrate autonomous clip positioning on a physical phantom in laparoscopic surgery, one of the most common interventions in general surgery. After segmentation of a colorless point cloud from a single camera, target positions for the clips are extracted using spline interpolation, and can then be adjusted by the human operator. The segmentation model is trained on only 60 hand-labeled real point clouds, reflecting data scarcity in the surgical domain. We overcome this with a combination of pre-training on 128,000 synthetic point clouds and two novel data augmentation techniques. The motion of the end-effector to each target is visualized for the operator, satisfying the unique motion constraints of minimally-invasive surgery while ensuring that the robot's actions are verifiable and interpretable. In real robot experiments, our system localizes targets with the required precision of 0.75mm at a 95% success rate and executes autonomous clip positioning with a 100% success rate. We provide insights that are applicable to many other surgical and non-surgical tasks that require identifying and navigating to a precise target. Source code and project page: https://github.com/balazsgyenes/kirurc
tldr: This paper presents the first robotic system for autonomous clip positioning in laparoscopic cholecystectomy on a phantom, using point cloud segmentation trained on synthetic data and novel augmentations to achieve high precision and interpretability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了首个在腹腔镜胆囊切除术体模上实现自主夹子定位的机器人系统，利用合成数据和新型数据增强技术训练点云分割模型，实现了高精度和可解释性。
summary_zh: 机器人领域的高风险应用，如机器人辅助手术，带来了独特的挑战。这些系统必须同时具备高精度和可解释性，才能部署在对错误或不安全探索容忍度极低的环境中。我们提出了首个在腹腔镜手术中（这是普外科最常见的手术之一）的实体模型上展示自动夹子定位的机器人系统。在从单个摄像头分割出无色点云后，通过样条插值提取夹子的目标位置，然后可由操作员手动调整。该分割模型仅使用60个手工标注的真实点云进行训练，反映了手术领域的数据稀缺性。我们通过结合在128,000个合成点云上的预训练以及两种新颖的数据增强技术来克服这一难题。末端执行器到每个目标的运动路径会可视化呈现给操作员，这既满足了微创手术的独特运动约束，又确保了机器人动作的可验证性和可解释性。在实际机器人实验中，我们的系统以95%的成功率实现了0.75毫米所需精度的目标定位，并以100%的成功率执行了自动夹子定位。我们提供的见解适用于许多其他需要识别并导航至精确目标的外科及非外科任务。源代码与项目页面：https://github.com/balazsgyenes/kirurc

title: Lung-R1: A Knowledge Graph-Guided LLM for Pulmonary Diagnostic Reasoning
summary: Diagnosing pulmonary diseases requires integrating heterogeneous evidence amid phenotypic variability and cross-disease overlap. Although large language models (LLMs) have shown progress on pulmonary knowledge question answering (QA) and information-processing tasks, reliable pulmonary diagnosis requires patient-specific, relation-aware reasoning over electronic medical record (EMR) evidence rather than isolated knowledge recall. We define this gap between pulmonary knowledge and case-level diagnostic reasoning as the Pulmonary Knowledge-to-Diagnosis Gap. To address it, we introduce LungKG, the first structured pulmonary knowledge graph for diagnostic knowledge organization and record-grounded reasoning. LungKG contains 59,038 nodes and 164,308 edges across 15 entity types and 112 relation types, serving as both a reusable pulmonary knowledge resource and the foundation for LungKG-guided model adaptation. Built on LungKG, we propose Lung-R1, a LungKG-guided pulmonary LLM trained through KG-constrained reasoning-chain construction and KG-guided reinforcement learning. In a 20-system evaluation, Lung-R1-14B achieves state-of-the-art performance across Choice, Pulmonary-QA, and EMR Diagnosis, reaching an EMR Diagnosis score of 4.3583 and surpassing the strongest non-Lung-R1 baseline by 0.1476 points. These results demonstrate the value of LungKG-guided training for EMR-based pulmonary diagnosis.
tldr: This paper introduces LungKG, the first structured pulmonary knowledge graph, and Lung-R1, an LLM trained via KG-constrained reasoning and reinforcement learning to improve pulmonary diagnostic reasoning from electronic medical records, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LungKG，首个结构化的肺部知识图谱，以及基于知识图谱约束推理和强化学习训练的Lung-R1大语言模型，用于提升基于电子病历的肺部诊断推理能力，取得了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 诊断肺部疾病需要在表型变异性和跨疾病重叠中整合异质性证据。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在肺部知识问答（QA）和信息处理任务方面取得了进展，但可靠的肺部诊断需要基于电子病历（EMR）证据进行患者特异性、关系感知的推理，而非孤立的知识回忆。我们将肺部知识与病例级诊断推理之间的这一差距定义为"肺部知识-诊断鸿沟"。为解决这一问题，我们引入了LungKG——首个用于诊断知识组织和记录依据推理的结构化肺部知识图谱。LungKG包含59,038个节点和164,308条边，涵盖15种实体类型和112种关系类型，既作为可复用的肺部知识资源，又作为LungKG引导的模型适应的基础。基于LungKG，我们提出了Lung-R1——一种通过KG约束的推理链构建和KG引导的强化学习训练的、LungKG引导的肺部大语言模型。在20系统评估中，Lung-R1-14B在选择题、肺部问答和EMR诊断任务上均达到最优性能，EMR诊断得分为4.3583，超过最强非Lung-R1基线0.1476分。这些结果证明了LungKG引导训练对于基于EMR的肺部诊断的价值。

title: UniReason-Med: A Shared Grounded Reasoning Interface for 2D-to-3D Transfer in Medical VQA
summary: We study whether grounded reasoning supervision from abundant 2D medical images can improve 3D medical VQA when both input types are aligned through a common reasoning interface. We introduce UniReason-Med, a single-checkpoint framework that processes either a 2D image or a slice-serialized 3D volume at inference time, generating interleaved textual reasoning and localized visual evidence through shared box syntax, region-token injection, and a common grounded reasoning policy. To train this interface, we construct UniMed-CoT, a 220K instruction-tuning dataset with interleaved textual reasoning and grounded visual evidence, including 170K 2D and 50K 3D samples. Through supervised fine-tuning followed by outcome-level reinforcement learning, UniReason-Med learns to generate grounded reasoning traces without IoU/Dice-based localization rewards during RL. Data-mixture and component ablations show that joint 2D+3D grounded supervision substantially improves 3D reasoning over 3D-only training, while grounding and region-token injection consistently benefit both 2D and 3D tasks. These results suggest that a shared grounded reasoning interface can transfer reasoning structure from 2D images to slice-serialized volumetric medical understanding. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/IQuestLab/unireason-med.
tldr: UniReason-Med introduces a shared grounded reasoning interface that unifies 2D and 3D medical VQA by using common box syntax, region-token injection, and a single checkpoint, demonstrating that joint 2D+3D supervised training improves 3D reasoning over 3D-only training.
tldr_zh: UniReason-Med 提出了一个共享的接地推理接口，通过统一的边界框语法、区域标记注入和单一检查点，统一了 2D 和 3D 医学视觉问答，证明了联合 2D+3D 监督训练比仅使用 3D 训练能提升 3D 推理能力。
summary_zh: 我们研究了当两种输入类型通过共同的推理接口对齐时，来自大量二维医学图像的基于定位的推理监督能否提升三维医学视觉问答的性能。我们提出了UniReason-Med，一个单检查点框架，在推理时可处理二维图像或序列化切片的三维体积，通过共享的边界框语法、区域标记注入和共同的定位推理策略生成交错排列的文本推理和局部化视觉证据。为了训练该接口，我们构建了UniMed-CoT，一个包含22万条指令微调数据集，带有交错排列的文本推理和定位视觉证据，包括17万条二维样本和5万条三维样本。通过监督微调后接结果层面的强化学习，UniReason-Med学会了生成定位推理轨迹，而无需在强化学习过程中使用基于IoU/Dice的定位奖励。数据混合和组件消融实验表明，联合二维+三维定位监督相比仅使用三维训练能显著提升三维推理能力，而定位和区域标记注入对二维和三维任务均有持续增益。这些结果表明，一个共享的定位推理接口可以将推理结构从二维图像迁移到序列化切片的三维体积医学理解中。代码和数据已在https://github.com/IQuestLab/unireason-med公开。
